content: Official M49 country/area classification lives at unstats.un.org/unsd/methodology/m49/ (table with Global/Region/Sub-region codes, Country or Area, M49 Code, ISO-alpha3 Code) but has no scriptable CSV/API export (JS-triggered download buttons only). The SDG API's own GeoArea/Tree endpoint (unstats.un.org/SDGAPI/v1/sdg/GeoArea/Tree) returns a live, queryable tree with a type field (Region/Country/Other areas/Major Fishing Areas/Large Marine Ecosystems) and children (null for leaf countries) -- this is a directly API-native way to build the canonical country list and exclude regional aggregates, satisfying D-13's intent of aligning with the data source itself, though it does not provide ISO3 codes.
